exact_application_policy.C1: PASS only if one common palette of size <=3 contains every active exact list after propagation.
exact_application_policy.C2: PASS only on distinct future-complete Q_ALL dependency blocks with exact local carriers.
exact_application_policy.C3: PASS only for information already captured by sealed component messages, D_C incidence, selectors and B2A transition signatures.
exact_application_policy.C4: PASS only when the exact frozen preconditions of a named sealed carrier hold; similarity to a separator/interface pattern is insufficient.
exact_application_policy.C5: PASS only with a certified permutation or interval representation/class membership and bounded total colour set.
exact_application_policy.C6: PASS only with a proven constant width bound and a polynomially supplied decomposition; no width-optimization oracle is assumed.
exact_application_policy.C7: PASS only for the exact bipartite P7-free active core and the published decomposition construction; then route to C6.
exact_application_policy.C8: PASS only if the declared future R1/R2/source/reconstruction contract factorizes exactly across the proposed secondary decomposition.
exact_application_policy.C9: PASS only if every active future graph in the carrier lifecycle is certified P5-free and the total colour count is fixed.

reuse_findings.known_width_warning: The source-valid subdivided-wall family prevents promotion of C6 into a universal bounded-mim theorem.

candidate_must: remain one connected Q_ALL block after A/B/C
have a source-justified stress surface such as superpolynomial realizable profiles
have all four colours future-query active
fail C1-C9 by exact precondition receipts
fail any binding later E2 addendum
not be closed by secondary exact factorization
